title: Jais and Jais-chat: Arabic-Centric Foundation and Instruction-Tuned Open Generative Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Zero-shot evaluation using the CrowS-Pairs dataset to assess stereotype biases and measuring the model's propensity to favor stereotypic sentences over anti-stereotypic ones.
Zero-shot evaluation using the CrowS-Pairs dataset to assess stereotype biases against protected attributes, including religion.
Zero-shot evaluation using the CrowS-Pairs dataset to assess stereotype biases against protected attributes, including age.

Comparative evaluation of model performance on parallel Arabic and English benchmarks (e.g., MMLU, EXAMS, Vicuna-Instructions-80) to demonstrate the mitigation of the English-centric bias typically found in large language models.
